t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Learn what colour gnome corresponds to which basket and that will help you in your progress in the game.  the baskets are either red or yellow so match them up with the relavant gnome. make sure that you keep an eye on the multiplier as that is where you make points.

vb_textbox.text: Just when i thought i had a flow with the colours, it changes.  i'm afraid i couldn't find a sequence that i would be confident in passing onto you in good conscience and wouldn't want to mis-lead anyone.  I wish you all the luck in the game.
